entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [runtime-async] Consider optimizing continuations to avoid storing unused return values #115686
    Future
  • Http1RawResponseStreamConformanceTests.CopyToAsync_AllDataCopied test timeout #115683
  • Clarify the true semantics of `EventId` #115682
  • [API Proposal]: System.Random.NextUInt64 #115681
  • JIT: An in-bound array access does not eliminate bound checks #115679
  • Uri.Segments is a very expensive footgun #115675

Closed

  • Assertion failed '0 <= imm8 && imm8 < count' during 'Lowering nodeinfo' #115532
  • Test failure: JIT/HardwareIntrinsics/General/Vector256_1/Vector256_1_ro/Vector256_1_ro.cmd #115459
  • JIT: x86 SPMI replay failing under JitStressRegs=8 with Assertion failed 'emitVerifyEncodable(ins, EA_SIZE(attr), reg)' during 'Generate code' (IL size 504; hash 0x20a38a17; MinOpts) #115644
  • Assertion failed '(insCodesMR[ins] != BAD_CODE)' during 'Generate code #115487
  • [Bug] UTF8 decoder fail to decode a byte array in a WASM app on combo Android ARM + Chrome + AOT #106755

PullRequests

Created

  • Added an additional yield point prior to possibly long running initialization #115688
    area-System.Net.Http, community-contribution
  • JIT: Avoid running return value copy logic for unused return value #115687
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Cleanup Windows-simulating semaphore in PAL #115685
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Skip adding NullChangeToken instances to the composite list #115684
    area-Extensions-FileSystem, community-contribution
  • Delete obsolete comments #115680
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Notify attached debugger of NAOT exception #115678
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Merged

  • [clr-interp] Add safepoints at method entry and backwards branch #115567
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Fix some mismatches in <inheritdoc /> #115653
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Fix XML inheritdoc of Single/Double.SinCosPi() #115651
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Revert "Vector128.WithElement codegen regression in .NET 9.0 #115645
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [Android] Include static native libraries in CoreCLR Android runtime pack #115610
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, os-android
  • Arm64: Implement region write barriers #111636
    arch-arm64, area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add ML-KEM X.509 key accessors to Microsoft.Bcl.Cryptography #115656
    area-System.Security
  • Revert "Create a single copy of stub templates" #115665
    area-VM-coreclr

Updated

  • [RuntimeAsync] ilasm/ildasm support for the MethodImpl.Async (Take 2) #115658
    area-ILTools-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Collapse the recent ILStub generation patterns into a helper #115673
    area-Interop-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • [Android] Run CoreCLR library tests on Android #114148
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, os-android, 10.0.0
  • Consume libraries that we vendor fully by building separately and using a custom prefix path #113176
    area-System.IO.Compression
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2711670 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • [clr-interp] Implement array support for primitive types #115553
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • JIT: Fix handling for SIMD types in async transformation #115652
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Move GenTreeIntCon::gtCompileTimeHandle field to be a global map #115542
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Move FLS init before EventPipeAdapter::FinishInitialize and the first SetupThread() #115546
    area-VM-coreclr
  • JIT: use root compiler instance for sufficient PGO observation #115119
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Use UnsafeAccessorType in System.Private.CoreLib and the BCL #115583
    needs-area-label
  • Instrinic support for transient codegen. #115639
    area-VM-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • Share allocation helpers between CoreCLR and NativeAOT #115339

  • Fix invalid continuation caused by exception after inlining in `TryRunInline` #115659

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #115545

  • Remove always searching executable directory for native libraries in single-file applications #115236
